title: LiteFish
description: New Fishing System | Custom Drop | Custom Baits | Biomes | Economy | Tournaments
body:
## Need a Custom Plugin?
Our studio also accepts commissions of any complexity.
If you want a fully custom plugin for your server - mechanic, system, minigame, or optimization tool - we can build it for you.  
[Join our Discord to request your own project.](https://discord.gg/PgDfrQx22f)

# In-Game GUI Configuration
Full plugin configuration via in-game GUI—no need to edit files!  
![ ](https://i.imgur.com/Ztnzw93.gif)

# Custom Loot Placement
Place custom loot anywhere—merge biomes, worlds, and regions effortlessly.
![ ](https://i.imgur.com/86AUV8g.png)
![ ](https://i.imgur.com/86AUV8g.png)

# Lava Fishing Anywhere
Fish in lava across any biome and dimension.
![ ](https://i.imgur.com/nhHAwuR.gif)

# Void Fishing
Catch fish even in The Void dimension.
![ ](https://i.imgur.com/7DSV2wJ.gif)

# Loot Multiplier
Increase your loot and make fishing more rewarding and fun.
![ ](https://i.imgur.com/vOHrIIo.gif)

# Bobber Multiplier
Unique modifiers to enhance your fishing experience.
![ ](https://i.imgur.com/aV9Czyo.gif)

# High Performance
Optimized plugin capable of generating hundreds of thousands of drops per second without server lag.
![ ](https://i.imgur.com/3MjQ4XA.png)

# Hot Spot
Create unique fishing spots.
![ ](https://i.imgur.com/3MjQ4XA.gif)
![ ](https://i.imgur.com/ZQgPNeo.gif)

# Fish Trap
Create various fish traps and catch AFK.
![ ](https://i.imgur.com/bjm36qH.gif)

# Custom Rods System
Create custom rods with internal slots for runes or baits—upgrade and enhance them for a stronger fishing experience.
![ ](https://i.imgur.com/p7qL151.gif)
![ ](https://i.imgur.com/8vfuGje.gif)

# Bait System
Craft various types of baits and runes to enhance your fishing adventures.
![ ](https://i.imgur.com/QSfNNi6.gif)

# Aquariums
Use Aquarium to store fish and increase their weight over time.
![ ](https://i.imgur.com/YYBNspE.gif)

# Enchantment System
Create unique enchantments for your fishing rods.
![ ](https://i.imgur.com/9dT4VEm.gif)

# Advanced Fishing
A mini games with a texture pack is included in the plugin.
![ ](https://i.imgur.com/e20MCmO.gif)
![ ](https://i.imgur.com/b47WL3f.gif)
![ ](https://i.imgur.com/QxhT5zY.gif)

# MiniGames System
Support for various mini-games
![ ](https://i.imgur.com/6eBOO4I.gif)
![ ](https://i.imgur.com/8camzX6.gif)
![ ](https://i.imgur.com/kP6zmmW.gif)

# Hidden traits
Discover how to catch rare fish under specific conditions, such as only during a full moon.
After catching a fish, players can view its full characteristics and choose to share it with other players or keep it secret.
![ ](https://i.imgur.com/pT1nRUc.gif)

# Level system
Allows you to level up your character and unlock new types of fish.
![ ](https://i.imgur.com/BG4gHeh.gif)

# Fishing catalog (INDEX)
Explore the world, study locations, and discover new fish species for your collection.
![ ](https://i.imgur.com/6EJ5vmd.gif)
![ ](https://i.imgur.com/HOlmlPc.gif)

# Treasures
Find valuable treasures hidden in water bodies.
![ ](https://i.imgur.com/mVt6Dop.gif)
